answer: Collateral here must be committed before the round's words exist publicly: a randomness beacon reveals terms such as lotus or comet only after the lock closes, so nobody can fund just the accounts that later get scored. At 50 POA per account, 1,000 fakes tie up 50,000 POA every round, growing linearly with n. A ledger check flags locks moved after the reveal; those stakes are forfeited. Colluders cannot pool one deposit, since each lock is bound to one account for the round. Honest agents lock once and get it back at close.
